'''Aristotle South Pipeline''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://etnatownship.community.diligentoneplatform.com/document/42a8d82d-2c80-448b-b7e3-b9739e451143/|title=etnatownship.community.diligentoneplatform.com|website=etnatownship.community.diligentoneplatform.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Socrates South power plant, New Albany, Ohio to Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage interconnect, Liberty Township, Fairfield County, Ohio.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://etnatownship.community.diligentoneplatform.com/document/42a8d82d-2c80-448b-b7e3-b9739e451143/|title=etnatownship.community.diligentoneplatform.com|website=etnatownship.community.diligentoneplatform.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
